description: Implementation of SSLKeyLogger for logging SSL keys, managing file I/O on background threads, with mechanisms to handle slow writes and file operations.

classes.name: SSLKeyLoggerImpl::Core
classes.description: Manages background file operations for SSL key logging, including opening files, writing lines, and flushing buffers asynchronously.

methods.name: SSLKeyLoggerImpl::SSLKeyLoggerImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the core and opens the specified file.

methods.name: SSLKeyLoggerImpl::SSLKeyLoggerImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the core and sets an existing file.

methods.name: SSLKeyLoggerImpl::WriteLine
methods.description: Delegates writing a line to the core for asynchronous logging.
